title: Blind Noise Equalization for Large Data Matrices under General Variance Profiles
abstract: arXiv:2611.08784v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-rank approximation is a basic tool for inference from large and noisy data matrices. However, when noise variances differ across entries, a setting known as heteroskedasticity, the noise can distort the observed spectrum, producing spurious components and obscuring weak signals. To address these challenges, we develop BRINE (Blind Resolvent-based Iterative Noise Equalizer), a data-driven procedure that iteratively rescales rows and columns to equalize the average noise variance across both dimensions. Under suitable conditions, this procedure restores the Marchenko-Pastur law for the noise spectrum and can amplify signal components without prior knowledge of the signal or noise structure. A key idea underlying our approach is to equalize the diagonal entries of the data resolvent as a proxy for equalizing the unknown noise variances. translated_title: 一般方差分布下大型数据矩阵的盲噪声均衡化
translated_abstract: 低秩近似是从大型含噪数据矩阵中进行推断的基本工具。然而，当噪声方差在各元素之间不尽相同时（这一情形被称为异方差性），噪声会扭曲观测到的谱，产生虚假成分并掩盖微弱信号。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了BRINE（基于预解式的盲迭代噪声均衡器），这是一种数据驱动的方法，通过迭代地对行和列进行重新缩放，以均衡两个维度上的平均噪声方差。在适当条件下，该过程能够恢复噪声谱的Marchenko-Pastur定律，并且无需事先了解信号或噪声结构即可放大信号成分。我们方法的一个关键思想是均衡数据预解式的对角元素，以此作为均衡未知噪声方差的代理。在总体层面，我们识别出一个刻画这种均衡化过程的势函数……
tldr: 该论文提出了BRINE方法，通过迭代重缩放行与列来均衡未知噪声方差，从而在异方差噪声下恢复大型数据矩阵噪声谱的Marchenko-Pastur定律并放大信号成分，且无需预先了解信号或噪声结构。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes BRINE, a data-driven procedure that iteratively rescales rows and columns to equalize unknown noise variances, restoring the Marchenko-Pastur law for the noise spectrum of large data matrices under heteroskedasticity and amplifying signal components without prior knowledge of the signal or noise structure.
